en.headline: Customs seize five suspected endangered turtles in US package at airport
en.dek: Officers found the live turtles, valued at about HK$50,000, inside a parcel from the United States declared as toy model gift boxes; the case has been referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.
body: Hong Kong Customs seized five live turtles suspected of being controlled endangered species at Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday. The animals, estimated to be worth about HK$50,000 in total, were found in a package imported from the United States that was declared to contain toy model gift boxes.

Customs officers selected the parcel for inspection through risk assessment. After examining it, they discovered the turtles. The case has been handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for follow-up.

Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, it is an offence to import, export or possess endangered species without the required permit. Conviction can bring a maximum fine of HK$10 million and 10 years' imprisonment, and the items are subject to forfeiture. Customs urged the public to report suspected smuggling via its 24-hour hotline.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5隻懷疑瀕危活龜 藏美國進口玩具模型包裹
zh.dek: 關員在一個報稱載有玩具模型禮盒的美國進口包裹中發現活龜，估計市值約5萬元，案件已轉交漁護署跟進。
body: 香港海關星期六在香港國際機場檢獲5隻懷疑屬受管制瀕危物種的活龜，估計總市值約5萬元。關員透過風險評估檢查一個由美國進口、報稱載有玩具模型禮盒的包裹，發現該批活龜。
案件已轉交漁農自然護理署跟進調查。海關指，根據《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》，非按規定進出口或管有瀕危物種屬違法，一經定罪最高可被判罰款1000萬元及監禁10年，物品亦會被充公。
海關呼籲市民切勿攜帶受管制物品進出香港，並可致電24小時熱線182 8080舉報懷疑走私活動。
